name: chrome-shared
description: Shared Chrome automation for Claude Code: one browser instance shared by all sessions (CDP port 9226), lazy launch on first use, window-per-session via isolated contexts, and user-visible tab numbers ([N] in tab titles) as a shared reference between the user and Claude. Launches Chrome without automation flags. Bundles debugging skills adapted from ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp (Apache-2.0).
